links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of AI models vs consultant and resident physicians against definitive diagnosis
links.effect: Consultant 96.6%; ChatGPT with clinical data 86.9%, Copilot 81.4%, Gemini 78.7%; resident 72.5%. Consultant superior to all other interpreters and models (p < .001).
links.quote: The consultant's diagnostic performance was significantly superior to all other interpreters and models (p < .001 for all comparisons).

unlisted_practices: Supplementing image-based AI diagnosis with clinical data improves accuracy (image-only vs image-plus-clinical-data input)

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic performance of commercial multimodal AI models (with and without clinical context) against clinician readers on a prospectively collected dataset; it tests model capability rather than an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
